title: Army Logistics Data Analytics Platform
contractType: Firm-fixed-price with labor-hour CLINs, 1 base year and 4 option years
relativeImportance: Technical Approach is more important than Management Approach, which is of equal importance to Past Performance. All non-price factors combined are significantly more important than Price.

factors.name: Technical Approach
factors.criteria: The Government will evaluate the soundness of the offeror's approach to forecasting equipment failures from Army maintenance data, integrating with GCSS-Army and legacy STAMIS feeds (including for units operating disconnected), and achieving and maintaining an authorization to operate under the Army RMF.

factors.name: Management Approach
factors.criteria: The Government will evaluate the qualifications and committed availability of the Program Manager and Lead Data Scientist, the realism of the 60-day transition-in plan, and the offeror's quality control approach.

factors.name: Past Performance
factors.criteria: The Government will assess its confidence that the offeror will successfully perform, based on recent (within 5 years) and relevant performance on Army or DoD logistics and analytics efforts, using CPARS, FAPIIS and references.

factors.name: Price
factors.criteria: Price will be evaluated for reasonableness and balance. Total evaluated price is the sum of all CLINs for the base and option periods.
